messages.subject: Green Energy Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Dominic,

The Green Recruitment Company's global work across renewable energy, infrastructure, energy storage, sustainability and net zero aligns strongly with my leadership background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where energy-transition growth depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
